name: http
description: Make any HTTP request on the web: call APIs, submit forms, download things. Give a method, a url, optional headers, and a body (json for a JSON body, form for a form-encoded body, or body for raw text). Anywhere in the headers, url or body you can write {{CHARLIE_SOMETHING}} (or {{GITHUB_TOKEN}}), and it is replaced with that secret from your environment, so you never have to see or type it. Returns the status, the important headers, and the response body: JSON is parsed, and HTML is reduced to readable text unless raw is true. Use web_fetch to just read a page; use this to act.

raw.description: Return HTML as-is instead of readable text.

max_chars.description: How much of the body to return (default 12000).
